entities.name: S3 Drop Bucket
entities.rationale: Green S3 icon at top-left (AWS_Icon_8), labeled 'S3'. Drop bucket receiving flat files/order-level data from the ERP system. Located outside the dashed box.

entities.name: SQS
entities.rationale: SQS icon at top (AWS_Icon_9), labeled 'SQS'. Triggered when files land in the S3 drop bucket; handles messaging and launches the initiator Lambda.

entities.name: Initiator Lambda
entities.rationale: Orange Lambda icon (AWS_Icon_6), labeled 'LAMBDA', below SQS. Initiator Lambda job that reads metadata from DynamoDB and populates the data lake.

entities.name: DynamoDB
entities.rationale: DynamoDB icon (AWS_Icon_3), labeled 'DYNAMODB', below the initiator Lambda. Stores metadata and key information about incoming files.

entities.name: Data Lake
entities.rationale: Icon labeled 'DATA LAKE' (AWS_Icon_7), to the right of the initiator Lambda. Data lake made of raw and refined S3 buckets, with an event-driven S3 trigger that launches the second Lambda.

entities.name: Complex Lambda
entities.rationale: Orange Lambda icon (AWS_Icon_4), labeled 'LAMBDA', below the Data Lake. Complex Lambda job that merges order and inventory sales data, applies rules and Python stats models to create demand, then feeds Redshift.

entities.name: Redshift
entities.rationale: Purple Redshift icon (AWS_Icon_5), labeled 'REDSHIFT', on the right. Cluster populated by DMS and by the complex Lambda; makes data available to the data lake and to business users' analytics.

entities.name: VPN
entities.rationale: VPN icon (AWS_Icon_1), labeled 'VPN', at the bottom. Drawn inside the pink dashed boundary that separates the on-prem building from the AWS side; on-premises data is piped through it.

entities.name: DMS
entities.rationale: Purple DMS icon (AWS_Icon_2), labeled 'DMS', bottom centre, to the right of VPN and inside/under the pink dashed boundary line. Uses CDC to pull on-premises sales data and load it into Redshift.

entities.name: On-Prem Database
entities.rationale: Hand-drawn pink building labeled 'ON PREM' at bottom-left, outside (left of) the pink dashed boundary. Represents the on-premises database holding invoice-level sales data.

visual_connections.description: Green curved arrow from the top of S3 arcing over to the top of SQS; files landing in the drop bucket kick off SQS.
Green curved arrow from the left side of SQS down to the left side of the first Lambda; SQS launches the initiator Lambda job.
Green curved arrow from the left side of the first Lambda down to the left side of DynamoDB; Lambda pulls file metadata from DynamoDB.
Green horizontal arrow from the first Lambda right to the Data Lake; Lambda pushes data into the raw and refined buckets.
Green curved arrow from the left side of the Data Lake down to the left side of the second Lambda; S3 event trigger launches the complex Lambda job.
Short green horizontal arrow from the second Lambda right to Redshift; merged and demand data is fed into Redshift.
Green curved arrow from the top of Redshift arcing up and left to the top of the Data Lake; Redshift data made available back to the data lake.
Green horizontal arrow from the on-prem building right to the VPN icon, crossing the pink dashed boundary.
Green horizontal arrow from VPN right to DMS; data pulled through the VPN using DMS and CDC.
Green arrow from the right side of DMS curving up to the bottom of Redshift; DMS populates the Redshift cluster.
